CODE
2.3.11. 
Effects to third parties
 A matrimonial agreement concluded before the celebration of the marriage takes effect vis--vis third parties on the celebration of the marriage, provided that it is entered in the central register of matrimonial agreements. In the absence of such registration, clauses derogating from the legal regime cannot be invoked against third parties who have contracted with these spouses in ignorance of their matrimonial agreements.
 A matrimonial agreement entered into during the marriage ceases to have effect vis--vis third parties on the day it is entered in the central register of matrimonial agreements, unless the spouses have informed third parties of the change in their agreements with them.
